items.stem: A 60-page report needs an index of contents that updates when headings change. What is the correct approach?

options.text: Apply heading styles and insert an automatic table of contents that updates fields
options.rationale: Correct: a field-based TOC rebuilds from heading styles.

options.text: Type the contents list manually and edit it each time
options.rationale: A manual list does not update and drifts out of sync.

options.text: Take a screenshot of the headings
options.rationale: An image cannot update or be navigated.

options.text: Bold the first line of each page
options.rationale: Bolding is not a structural TOC source.

items.explanation: Correct: a field-based TOC rebuilds from heading styles.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO require section breaks rather than simple page breaks? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Different headers or footers in different parts of the document
options.rationale: Correct: header/footer changes need a new section.

options.text: Restarting page numbering after the contents page
options.rationale: Correct: numbering restart requires a section break.

options.text: Simply moving text to the next page
options.rationale: A page break suffices for that.
Formatting a word needs no break.

items.explanation: Correct: header/footer changes need a new section.

items.stem: Two reviewers must suggest edits that the author can accept or reject individually. What should be enabled?

options.text: Track Changes, with comments for discussion
options.rationale: Correct: tracked changes record reviewable, reversible edits.

options.text: Editing with tracking off and overwriting text
options.rationale: Untracked edits cannot be reviewed or reversed cleanly.

options.text: Locking the document from all edits

items.explanation: Correct: tracked changes record reviewable, reversible edits.
